claim_boundary: The figure documents DDPG learning mechanics only and does not describe the surrogate environment or episode sequence.
caption: Figure 3. Actor--critic architecture and learning equations used in the DDPG implementation. The online actor maps the three-dimensional state to a 12-dimensional normalized descriptor action, and the online critic evaluates the resulting state--action pair. Target copies provide the temporal-difference target and are updated softly using factor \(\tau\). The right panel summarizes the temporal-difference target, critic loss, actor objective, and target-network updates. Here, \(\mu\) denotes the actor policy, \(Q\) the action-value function, primed symbols the target networks, \(d_i\) the terminal indicator, and \(N\) the mini-batch size.
